name: Can standard wall paint be used on kitchen cabinets?

mainEntity.name: Can standard wall paint be used on kitchen cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Standard wall paint should not be used on kitchen cabinets because it lacks the hardness and chemical resistance needed for daily contact. Cabinets face frequent hand oils, spills, and impact, which quickly scuffs or softens standard latex wall paint. Cabinet projects demand specialized urethane-modified alkyds or hard-wearing cabinet enamels that cure to a smooth, durable finish. While standard wall paint dries faster and costs less up front, using it on cabinetry leads to chipping, peeling around handles, and sticky doors within months.
acceptedAnswer.description: No, standard wall paint lacks the hardness and durability for cabinetry. Cabinets require specialized enamels designed to resist hand oils, chipping, and frequent cleaning.
